paragraphs: In Ketubot 104a, R' Nachman bar Yitzchak said that Rav Yehudah bar Kaza recited in the baraita of Bar Kaza’s school.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קד. gives Ketubot 104a under the period convention, without independently checked named text. אר״נ is contextually Nachman said, supported by the connected bar-Yitzchak name; the title component remains R'.

תני is rendered recited/taught and מתניתא דבי בר קזא as baraita of Bar-Kaza’s-school. This does not independently establish a professional teacher role. Both Yehudah Rav occurrences are full; bare Bar Kaza gains no title.
